title: Battle of Aschaffenburg (1866)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Aschaffenburg (1866)", at revision 1370107076, opens: "The Battle of Aschaffenburg, sometimes also called The Skirmishes Near Aschaffenburg, was a battle of the Austro-Prussian War on 14 July 1866 between pitting the armies of Prussia on the one hand and parts of the VIII Corps of the German Federal Army on the other side which primarily consisted of soldiers from the Austrian Empire, Hesse-Darmstadt and Hesse-Kassel." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q589189, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1866 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
